title: Monster Of The Mountain Pass
paragraphs: After that, I continued enhancing Yuki-chan and the others’ abilities, and by the evening, I could confidently say they had grown considerably stronger. I might have gone a little overboard.
“Gua!”
“Gua, gua!”

Yuki-chan and the others were playfully frolicking around. They were already strong enough to casually take down the Heel Dog Familiars that appeared out of nowhere. For now, they were still in the middle of their growth, but their strength was more than sufficient. They were transitioning from their round and adorable second form to their third form. Even so, I could clearly feel the Filolials’ burning passion to run and fight. I placed the boss drops and other items into the bags hanging from each Filolial’s back.
“Well then, everyone! Use that enthusiasm to go and assist Father and the others.”
“Gua!”
For some reason, all the Filolials except Yuki-chan saluted and dashed off. It seemed they had already decided where they would go.
“Alright then, Yuki-chan. Let’s gather more drop items for those under Father’s care.”
“Gua!”
Yuki-chan saluted in response to my command and followed closely behind.

Since I had the chance, maybe I should prepare a carriage for the Filolials? That’s how the day passed, and I spent the night with Yuki-chan in the stable prepared by the inn next to the hunting grounds. By now, Father, Ren, and Itsuki were probably leveling up with the Filolials I had sent to them. The next day, I continued fighting in the depths of the hunting grounds. I had already gathered more than enough drops. By noon that day, I had dismantled the bosses and other monsters as souvenirs, loaded them onto the carriage I had quickly assembled, and returned to the central hotel. Since I had to prepare enough carriages for the Filolials, it ended up taking longer than expected. Yuki-chan looked quite happy pulling four carriages. Ah, now that I think about it, the meeting is scheduled for noon tomorrow. None of Father and the others had returned yet.
“This is going to be a hassle tomorrow.”
“Gua?”

Yuki-chan tilted her head. By tonight or early tomorrow morning, the Filolials would transform into their angelic forms. Considering that, I needed to prepare clothes for them. It’s not that I had forgotten. I had asked Fiancée to check, but the equipment at the Dracia Mountain Range’s hotel, which could turn magic into thread, was a bit outdated. That was a bit concerning.
“There’s still time, so let’s go procure it now!”
“Gua!”
Yuki-chan’s eyes sparkled brighter than ever, realizing that she could run. That’s right.

With Yuki-chan’s speed, I could quickly move around and use a portal to get what we need! The equipment is a bit large, but there’s no way we can’t bring it back. So, I entrusted the self-made carriage to the count who served as the guide, and Yuki-chan and I set off to procure the equipment that converts magic into thread. That night, a new legend of a speedster was born in the Dracia Mountain Range.
A new time attack record was set! --- The next day, at noon.
“Ah, welcome back, Motoyasu.”
“Que!”

Yuki-chan had already grown into her Filolial Queen form. It was about time for her to transform into her angelic form, but she seemed to be holding back, wanting to change together with the other Filolials. Sensing my intention, she had already used the equipment to make thread and even fabric in advance.
“I heard a rumor earlier… Apparently, something like a ghost or a monster sped through the mountain path leading here.”
“Oh? There’s such a rumor?”
“Yeah. Several people saw it yesterday. Even though it wasn’t nighttime yet, they said something white zipped by at incredible speed.”
As he spoke, Father was staring intently at Yuki-chan and pointing at her.
“It wasn’t Yuki-chan.”
“Eh… Well, yeah, that’s true. Motoyasu, you were supposed to be at the hunting grounds too.”
“No, we weren’t. Yesterday afternoon, Yuki-chan and I crossed the pass to procure the equipment that converts magic into thread.”
“Wait… if you’re having fun, I guess that’s all that matters.”
Father gave me a half-lidded, exasperated look without saying a word. That’s right. Raising Filolials is always fun.
“How’s everything going on your side?”
“Hm? Well, it’s going smoothly. Rifana, Raphtalia, and I have grown enough. At first, we were taking it slow under Melty’s supervision, but once Sakura joined us, our levels skyrocketed.”
“That’s great to hear.”
“We’ve practically mastered most of the strengthening methods, and I’ve unlocked so many shields that I’m now swamped just managing them.”

Ah, that’s a relief. With this much progress, there’s no way Father and the others would fall easily. I had been worried about when the Three Heroes Church’s assassins, reincarnators, or teleporters might attack.
“Well, there were a few adventurers who mistook Sakura-chan for a dangerous monster.”
“So, where is Sakura-chan now?”
“She’s with Melty right now.”
“Naofumi-sama—”
The sister’s friend approached, looking a little uneasy.
“Ah, Rifana-chan. Are you okay? I heard that growing pains can be rough.”
“I’m fine. Right, Raphtalia-chan?”
“Y-Yeah. It’s just that my bones keep cracking…”
“That doesn’t sound okay to me… Do you have a fever or anything?”
Father placed his hand on the sister’s forehead.
“Hmm… No fever, so I guess you’re fine?”
“Y-Yes.”
The sister looked a little embarrassed but still forced a smile.
Does she dislike being worried about? For some reason, I get the feeling there’s a bit of distance between her and Father. Or is it just my imagination?
“Right, Motoyasu mentioned it before, but seeing it in person is still surprising. Those adorable little chicks grow up so fast and even take on human form.”
“That’s the wonderful thing about Filolials.”
“Other worlds are amazing.”
And at that moment, Fiancée arrived. Behind her… was Sakura-chan, in her tall adult form, walking with a sleepy expression.
“Ah, Motoyasu—”
“Yes.”
Seeing that Sakura-chan had already transformed into her angelic form, Yuki-chan was left speechless for a moment before she immediately followed suit, transforming with a flash of light.
Is she trying to compete with Sakura-chan?
“You transformed too quickly! Oh, I wanted my first words to be for Motoyasu-sama, but I blurted them out without thinking!”
Yuki-chan pointed at Sakura-chan, then turned to me with a regretful expression.
“It’s fine. I’ve burned Yuki-chan’s first transformation into my memory.”
“Your phrasing is kind of… off.”
“Motoyasu-sama… Last night’s run was such a delightful time. I want to keep running even more.”
“Of course, I’ll make sure Yuki-chan has an environment where she can run to her heart’s content.”

Even in the previous loop, Yuki-chan had a great time participating in the Filolial races. I’ll make sure she gets to participate again this time. Though, Yuki-chan herself said that racing against Sakura-chan, Kou, and the other Filolials we raised was more of a challenge than the races. This time, we also have Kuro-chan. Come to think of it, I looped before I could fully analyze Kuro-chan’s unique traits, so I’d like to do that this time.
